svg.text: Confluence — as-built architecture (mapped to Figure 1 of the proposal)
Kappa architecture: one streaming path for live detection and historical replay. Module paths are relative to src/confluence/.
monitoring only — every action audited; thresholds operator-mediated
Explainability: TreeSHAP on every alert (Isolation Forest) · LIME + KernelSHAP on the tabular ensemble · plain-language narrative — explain/xai.py, narrative.py
Deployment: docker compose (TimescaleDB, Kafka, trainer, producer, consumer, API, dashboard, backup) · dashboard demo mode on Streamlit Community Cloud · design prototype on GitHub Pages
Solid arrows: data flow. Dashed arrow: control / monitoring flow. Detection layer boxes are the implemented models; Figure 1 components are all present.
